evidence: https://sigejp.pr.gov/server/rest/services/crim/crim_parcelas/MapServer/0 (CRIM parcel layer, listed in the server directory) returns 'Service crim/crim_parcelas/MapServer not started'
https://www.satasgis.crimpr.net/crimgis/rest/services/Mapas/Parcelas/MapServer/0 (listed in CRIM's ArcGIS Online web map) unreachable; http variant returns 404
https://gis.pr.gov/Pages/default.aspx links only to the CRIM Mapa Catastral web app (no REST endpoint)
note: Cidra (FIPS 72041) parcels are held by CRIM (about 1.25M island-wide). CRIM's ArcGIS parcel services are listed in the server directory and the ArcGIS Online map, but every endpoint I tried is stopped or unreachable. Other Cidra hits are student or municipal test layers, not tax parcels. Parcels are reachable only through the CRIM web viewer right now.
